Because: the plan already contains an honest dependency DAG (ec-plan.md:320) but ec-execute.md:121 discards it and walks document order, spawning 130 subagents serially; coarser task granularity would delete the per-task Verify (local) evidence that makes the pipeline accurate, and trimming prompt overhead leaves the serial walk intact. Non-goal: parallelising plan prose authoring.

Planning feature: Independence Scheduling - dependency waves, batched probes, concurrent review. Tasks: 24. Files: commands/ec-execute.md, commands/ec-refine.md, commands/ec-plan.md, commands/ec-review.md, tests/test_command_docs.py, README.md. Core change: ec-execute levels the plan DAG into concurrent waves (WAVE_WIDTH=8) instead of walking tasks in document order; GATE and Verify (global) are wave barriers; orchestrator keeps sole plan-file write authority. ec-refine and ec-plan batch their read-only probes into one timeout-wrapped script. ec-review fans out its Stage 2 gates as concurrent reviewers.
